archive.warning: Open-Meteo describes the pre-operational ECMWF IFS Cycle 49R1 portion as hindcasts. This evaluation does not establish historical API availability.

periods.test_reuse_disclosure: The 2025 period was previously evaluated using ERA5-domain inputs and is therefore a reused test period, not a pristine confirmatory test.

issue_policy.definition: issue_time = run_initialisation_time + latency; valid_time = issue_time + lead
issue_policy.alert_validity: Each scheduled alert is valid from its target time until the next target time (12 hours, half-open). An episode is assigned to the latest target at or before onset.
issue_policy.nominal_lead_interpretation: The configured lead is the minimum issue-to-onset warning lead; actual episode lead is reported.

features.instantaneous_source: selected ecmwf_ifs single run at valid_time
features.antecedent_source: ecmwf_ifs Historical Forecast at hours <= issue_time plus selected single-run precipitation at hours > issue_time and <= valid_time

reference.forecast_to_reference_alignment: A forecast valid time on an IST half-hour is verified against the preceding whole IST reference hour.
reference.episode_verification: first positive hour and slope-eligible cells positive at onset

training.label_pipeline: existing app/train_trigger_model.py pipeline: rainfall-threshold positives, verified ASDMA vulnerable-cell rainfall triggers, and dated incident positives

calibration.objective: maximise pooled episode recall across configured leads
calibration.constraint: no more than 4 false-alert days in every fully evaluated monsoon month for every lead
calibration.tie_break: highest threshold, then fewest total false-alert days
calibration.failure_policy: record calibration failure and do not evaluate the test period

metrics.false_alert_unit: unique Asia/Kolkata target date with at least one unmatched district alert

recall_at_10.snapshot_rule: latest configured run whose latency-adjusted issue time is no later than local incident-day start minus lead
recall_at_10.cell_score: maximum priority index over the incident local day from the frozen snapshot
recall_at_10.tie_sensitivity: report whether the incident cell lies in the score-tied boundary set
